title: Face Elixir
short_description: Hydration and barrier support for mature, melanated skin.
details:
A luminous emulsion designed to hydrate, support barrier comfort, and help improve the appearance of uneven tone for mature, melanated skin.

NFE Face Elixir is the cornerstone of our Layered Care philosophy. This formula addresses barrier fragility, uneven-looking tone, and persistent dryness with restraint rather than product stacking.

Every ingredient is chosen with intention, from barrier-supporting ceramides to tone-supporting actives that work in harmony with the skin you have today.
benefits: Deeply hydrates and supports barrier comfort
Helps improve the appearance of uneven tone over time
Visibly softens the look of texture and crepiness
Non-comedogenic and suitable for sensitive skin
Layers calmly beneath sunscreen and makeup
usage:
Morning Ritual:

After cleansing, apply 1–2 pumps to face and neck. Gently press into skin using upward motions. Allow to absorb for 2–3 minutes before applying sunscreen.

Evening Ritual:

After cleansing and any treatment products recommended by your dermatologist, apply 1–2 pumps to face and neck. Massage gently until absorbed.

Pro Tip: For maximum absorption, apply to slightly damp skin or mist with a hydrating toner first.
ingredients_inci:
Key Actives:

  • Niacinamide — Supports barrier function and helps improve the appearance of uneven tone
  • Ceramides — Support the skin barrier and help lock in moisture
  • Hyaluronic Acid — Provides multi-level hydration
  • Peptides — Support a supple, resilient feel
  • Botanical Extracts — Antioxidant and soothing properties

Full INCI List:

Water (Aqua), Glycerin, Caprylic/Capric Triglyceride, Niacinamide, Cetearyl Alcohol, Glyceryl Stearate, Ceramide NP, Ceramide AP, Ceramide EOP, Hyaluronic Acid, Palmitoyl Tripeptide-1, Palmitoyl Tetrapeptide-7, Chamomilla Recutita (Matricaria) Flower Extract, Centella Asiatica Extract, Tocopherol, Allantoin, Phenoxyethanol, Ethylhexylglycerin.

texture_scent_experience:
Texture

A weightless, serum-oil hybrid that glides onto skin without heaviness or greasiness. The emulsion feels like a second skin: hydrating like a serum, nourishing like an oil, without leaving a residue.

Scent

No fragrance or perfume is added. Any soft aroma arises naturally from botanical actives, including trace amounts of Blue Tansy and Helichrysum essential oils, chosen for skin-comforting properties rather than scent.

Experience

Each application is a quiet moment of care. The formula absorbs quickly, leaving skin feeling supple, balanced, and ready for the next layer. The warm amber hue reflects the richness of natural actives, with no dyes or colorants added.
